verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online can be driven without its UI through the official V3 REST API SDK (with CRUD examples), an OAuth client that handles token management and refresh, and an official MCP server covering 29 entity types and 11 reports. A first-class sandbox environment supports isolated testing, which suits CI-style automation. The main caveat is that OAuth needs an interactive initial authorization, and production requires a public HTTPS callback, so fully unattended setup is not documented. Missing for 10: a documented CLI or CI/headless workflow guide, a non-interactive (service-account style) auth path, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
